harper: Opening a small PR to tighten Dedicated provisioning docs: fix wording on eviction vs preemption, add a tiny FAQ, drop obsolete SDK calls. PTAL.
mitul: link?
harper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921
jena: I'll own the SDK snippets. Which languages do we need? Python + Terraform + JS?
harper: yes, just minimal examples. Prefer Client.create() and provider block for terraform.
olivia: Found a confusing line about "reserved eviction window"  I'll suggest rewording to "eviction grace window" and add an example timeline.
mitul: Also add an ops note about isolation annotations so oncall can quickly route noisy tenants. Tiny YAML snippet is enough.
jena: Updated Python example and JS example in the PR. Replaced deprecated init calls.
docs-bot: link-checker  PR#4921  warnings: 1 anchor missing, 0 broken links.
harper: thanks all. I'll merge after the anchor fix and add a short follow-up issue to build a snippets index.
